help.title: How duplicates are handled
help.email: Same email address: the new details are merged into the existing lead. Every submission stays on that lead’s timeline.
help.phone: No email, but the same phone number: merged into that lead.
help.separate: A new email with a phone number we already have: kept as a separate lead and marked “Possible duplicate”, so two different people are never merged by mistake.
